Determine how many chunks we need\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    const std::uint64_t n_chunks =\n        (total_samples + chunk_size - 1) / chunk_size;   // ceiling division\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    //  2.  Launch one HPX task per chunk\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    using partial_t = std::pair<std::uint64_t, double>;   // {samples, sum}\n    std::vector<hpx::future<partial_t>> futures;\n    futures.reserve(n_chunks);\n\n    for (std::uint64_t c = 0; c < n_chunks; ++c)\n    {\n        // start index (inclusive) and size of this chunk\n        const std::uint64_t start = c * chunk_size;\n        const std::uint64_t size  = std::min(chunk_size,\n                                            total_samples - start);\n\n        // The lambda captures everything it needs by value (except the\n        // callable `f`, which is moved in via std::forward).\n        futures.emplace_back(\n            hpx::async(\n                [=, f = std::forward<F>(f)]() mutable -> partial_t\n                {\n                    double local_sum = 0.0;\n                    const double scale = b - a;\n\n                    for (std::uint64_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)\n                    {\n                        const std::uint64_t global_idx = start + i;\n                        const double u = sample_unit_interval(global_idx, seed);\n                        const double x = a + scale * u;          // point in [a,b]\n                        local_sum += f(x);                       // f(x) = e^{-x^2}\n                    }\n                    return {size, local_sum};\n                }));\n    }\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    //  3.
